title: Bridge

steps.text: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the mat.
steps.cue: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.

steps.text: Keep your feet hip-width apart and your arms beside you.
Press through your feet and lift your hips a small amount.
steps.cue: Press through your feet. Lift your hips a little.

steps.text: Hold for a couple of breaths, then lower your hips slowly.
steps.cue: Hold, then lower your hips slowly.

mistakes: Pushing the hips higher than feels comfortable for the lower back.
regression: Lift your hips only a few centimetres.
stopIf: Come down if you feel pain in your lower back or neck.

anatomy.why: The buttocks and the back of the thighs lift the hips, which opens the front of the body.
